'''Forbes & Company Limited''', the erstwhile Forbes [[Gokak]] Limited, is an Indian engineering, shipping and logistics company based in [[Mumbai]]. It was established in that city in 1767 by John Forbes of [[Aberdeenshire]], Scotland, a descendant of an ancient family of [[Lord Forbes of Pitsligo]].<ref name=UntoldLives>{{cite web|url=https://blogs.bl.uk/untoldlives/2013/01/forbes-and-company-one-of-the-oldest-businesses-in-the-world.html |title=Forbes & Company - one of the oldest businesses in the world |publisher=British Library, Untold Lives blog |date=2013-01-18 |access-date=2024-03-05}}</ref> Over the years, the management of the company moved from the Forbes family to the Campbells, to the [[Tata Group]], and finally to the [[Shapoorji Pallonji Group]]. It is [[List of oldest companies in India|one of the oldest companies of India]] and has been listed on the [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] since 1919.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/snapshots.cms?companyID=13711 |title=Company Profile: Forbes & Company Ltd. Company Information |publisher=Economictimes.indiatimes.com |date=1919-12-31 |access-date=2010-07-16}}</ref>

== Founder ==
Born in 1743, John Forbes set sail to India in 1764 on board the ship Asia as a purser on the East India Company's service. After three years as a 'free mariner' and later 'free merchant', he established a business to trade Indian cotton. The company later expanded into ship brokerage, ship building and banking.<ref name=UntoldLives />

== Business operations ==
Forbes & Company Limited is involved in three subsidiary companies:<ref>{{cite web |date= |title=Forbes & Company Limited Company Profile – 502865 INDIA Market Size, Market Share and Demand Forecast |url=http://wrightreports.ecnext.com/coms2/reportdesc_COMPANY_C356G5880 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080626221253/http://wrightreports.ecnext.com/coms2/reportdesc_COMPANY_C356G5880 |archive-date=2008-06-26 |access-date=2010-07-16 |website=Wrightreports.ecnext.com |publisher=Wright Reports}}</ref>

* Forbes Engineering: [[Robotics]], [[industrial automation]], [[Cutting tool (machining)|precision cutting tools]] and [[Spring (device)|springs]]
* Forbes Real Estate
* Forbes Technosys: [[Automated teller machine|ATM]] and banking [[kiosk]]s
